finding: NL-Alert (cell broadcast, no registration) nationwide since 8 Nov 2012; BE-Alert (SMS, email, voice; unregistered phones in a risk zone reachable by SMS) since 2017; Germany Cell Broadcast since Feb 2023, plus NINA app.
source: Dutch government (internetconsultatie.nl) - Concept toelichting Regeling alarmeringsdienst NL-Alert (21 Mar 2018); VRT NWS - BE-Alert kan alarmberichten nu ook verspreiden via digitale info (9 May 2022); Bundesregierung - Bundesweiter Warntag 2024
lead: Which alert channels reach phones today in BE (BE-Alert), NL (NL-Alert) and DE (Cell Broadcast / NINA), and since when?

finding: Interreg project Marhetak, launched after the 2021 floods (EUR 1.9m, to Dec 2023; incl. EMRIC), aimed to agree cross-border use of emergency materials; no results reported. No shelter or evacuation agreement found.
source: Waterschap Limburg - Marhetak (Interreg Euregio Maas-Rijn) project page
lead: Is there a cross-border agreement (e.g. Euregio Meuse-Rhine) for sharing shelters or evacuating across the border?

finding: About 50 emergency riverbank and structure repairs in the Vesdre valley, costing 16 million euro, were completed by 2026; 14 larger works in five communes are under way or starting in 2026.
source: Service public de Wallonie - 5 ans après les inondations de 2021 : où en est-on ? (26 Jun 2026)
lead: Vesdre and Meuse works since 2021 (SPW, reconstruction programme): dams, walls, river widening?

finding: Chaudfontaine demolished 13 flood-damaged houses along the Vesdre from March 2024 and scheduled 13 more on Avenue des Thermes from 12 November 2025 to widen the riverbed.
source: La DH / L'Avenir - 13 autres maisons sinistrées démolies à Chaudfontaine pour anticiper les futures montées de crues (5 Nov 2025)
lead: Homes demolished, bought out or rebuilt in Pepinster, Verviers, Chaudfontaine, Trooz?

finding: A Vesdre basin strategic scheme presented in June 2023 advises municipalities to avoid new construction in flood-risk zones; described as a vision for authorities, with no binding status stated.
source: L'Avenir - Le schéma stratégique invite à repenser collectivement le mode de vie dans le bassin de la Vesdre (2 Jul 2023)
lead: Walloon flood-hazard map updates or building bans in the Vesdre valley?

finding: Verviers presented a major-flood evacuation plan in February 2023 for about 4,600 people: three sectors, each with a 200-bed reception centre, vertical evacuation first; triggered by a regional crisis centre alert.
source: L'Avenir - Verviers : un plan d'action pour être plus efficace en cas d'inondations (28 Feb 2023)
lead: Updated provincial / municipal emergency plans; designated shelters with capacity?
Hospitals, care homes, power and water sites in the 2021 flood: moved or flood-proofed?

finding: By November 2024 Verviers had bought two vehicle-mounted alert sirens and announced a 15-page household preparedness brochure for every letterbox, recommending BE-Alert and the 112BE app.
source: L'Avenir - Une brochure prévention dans votre boîte aux lettres pour mieux anticiper les risques à Verviers (12 Nov 2024)
lead: Was BE-Alert used in July 2021? Campaigns, school programmes or volunteer networks since?

finding: Waterschap Limburg tendered on 4 Mar 2026 the strengthening of the Maas dike between Baarlo and Hout-Blerick (Venlo area), including a dike relocation; award planned 30 Nov, no construction or completion dates given.
source: Waterschap Limburg - news: tender for area development Baarlo - Hout-Blerick
lead: Maas dike reinforcements around Venlo (Waterschap Limburg, Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma)?

finding: RVO reports 1,518 applications and over EUR 34 million paid out under the WTS July 2021 scheme for Limburg flood damage by July 2022; the scheme is closed to new applications (province-wide figures).
source: RVO - Regeling WTS juli 2021 (waterschade Limburg)
lead: Damaged homes and businesses in North Limburg: repaired, compensated?

finding: Waterschap Limburg's Vierwaarden project near Venlo combines strengthening dikes at Velden and Venlo-Noord with more river room and nature; preferred alternative chosen autumn 2025, design phase 2026-2029, works 2029-2032.
source: Waterschap Limburg - project page Gebiedsontwikkeling Vierwaarden
lead: Room-for-the-river or zoning changes along the Maas since 2021?

finding: Limburg-Noord and Zuid-Limburg safety regions updated their Maas high-water disaster plan (2022-2025, published 5 Jan 2023) after the 2021 evaluations, adding an impact-analysis team and municipal evacuation guidance; annual updates planned.
source: Veiligheidsregio en GGD Limburg-Noord - Blad gemeenschappelijke regeling 2023 nr. 71: Rampbestrijdingsplan Hoogwater Limburg 2022-2025
lead: Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord evacuation and shelter plans updated?

finding: VieCuri hospital in Venlo evacuated 237 patients on 16 July 2021; the updated 2022-2025 Limburg high-water plan has the GHOR contact hospitals (VieCuri named) and care homes early.
source: Binnenlands Bestuur - Gemeenten moeten hun hoogwaterplan op orde brengen (26 Jan 2022); Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord - Rampbestrijdingsplan Hoogwater Limburg 2022-2025
lead: Care homes or hospitals evacuated in 2021 (e.g. Venlo, Roermond area); measures since?

finding: July 2021 Limburg evacuation advice (not an obligation) went out via NL-Alerts, air-raid sirens, church bells and regional broadcaster L1; overstroomik.nl, run by Rijkswaterstaat, safety regions and water boards, shows neighbourhood flood depths.
source: Expertise Netwerk Waterveiligheid - Hoogwater 2021: Feiten en Duiding (8 Sep 2021); overstroomik.nl
lead: NL-Alert use in July 2021; overstroomik.nl and campaigns since?

finding: Bad Münstereifel adopted a flood protection concept by June 2026: 20 measures plus three added, mostly retention basins (up to 500,000 m3). Land NRW pledged 18.7 M EUR in 2025; works aimed within 2-3 years.
source: Stadt Bad Münstereifel, Rundblick/Amtsblatt KW 24 (12.06.2026): Hochwasserschutzkonzept ist beschlossene Sache
lead: Steinbachtalsperre dam repair and safety review after the 2021 near-failure?

finding: Bad Münstereifel's mayor said in January 2026 that much flood damage is repaired, including bridges and parts of Erft walls in Iversheim, but experts expect about ten more years of rebuilding.
source: Stadt Bad Münstereifel, Ansprache Neujahrsempfang 2026 (Bürgermeister Glatzel)
lead: Rebuilding in Euskirchen / Bad Münstereifel area?

finding: Bezirksregierung Köln re-determined the 100-year floodplain of the Swistbach and tributaries including the Steinbach (Euskirchen, Swisttal and others); provisional protection took effect 17 October 2025, final ordinance pending.
source: Bezirksregierung Köln, Bekanntmachung Überschwemmungsgebiet Swistbach und Nebengewässer (26.08.2025)
lead: Updated flood zones (Überschwemmungsgebiete) on the Erft?
Kreis Euskirchen evacuation and shelter planning since 2021?

finding: Bad Münstereifel's flood-damaged fire station is to be replaced on the same site, built as flood-proof as possible; an interim hall is due end of 2026 and demolition of the old building starts early 2027.
source: Stadt Bad Münstereifel, Ansprache Neujahrsempfang 2026 (Bürgermeister Glatzel)
lead: Hospital, care homes, water and power sites hit in 2021: measures since?

finding: Bad Münstereifel's flood early-warning system, with 13 digital gauges on small streams, went into operation in 2025; soil-moisture sensors are being added in 2026.
source: Stadt Bad Münstereifel, Rundblick/Amtsblatt KW 24 (12.06.2026): Hochwasserschutzkonzept ist beschlossene Sache
lead: Sirens rebuilt? Warning-app and cell broadcast use? Campaigns?

finding: Two retention basins on the Vicht, in the Inde catchment (Rott 745,000 m³, Mulartshütte 394,000 m³): applied for January 2023, hearing April 2024, approval still pending then. Cost about €31 million; earliest completion end-2027.
source: Landtag NRW, Drucksache 18/10086 (state government answer on Rott/Mulartshütte basins, 22.07.2024)
lead: Inde river works around Eschweiler (Wasserverband Eifel-Rur)?

finding: Three years on (July 2024), Stolberg's rebuilding of flood-damaged roads, bridges, schools and the town hall was still under way; an outlet survey of over 3,000 people found most judged it too slow.
source: Mein Stolberg, 'Auch 3 Jahre nach der Flut gibt es noch viel zu tun in der Stadt' (14.07.2024)
lead: Rebuilding of flooded streets in Eschweiler centre?
Updated flood zones on the Inde?

finding: StädteRegion Aachen plans decentralised 'Katastrophenschutz-Leuchttürme' (equipped fire stations) for emergency calls and information during power cuts. Page gives no site count or start date and names neither Eschweiler nor Stolberg.
source: StädteRegion Aachen, 'Leuchttürme Katastrophenschutz' (web page, undated)
lead: StädteRegion Aachen evacuation and shelter plans updated?

finding: St.-Antonius-Hospital Eschweiler (basements flooded 14 July 2021, about €120 million damage) developed a new flood plan with a 4.50 m partly mobile barrier, extra stockpiles, and phone/IT moved to upper floors (reported 2026).
source: Rheinisches Ärzteblatt 6/2026, 'Gewappnet für Extremwetter-Ereignisse?'
lead: Eschweiler hospital evacuated in 2021? Flood-proofing since?

finding: Sirens partly rebuilt: 126 StädteRegion sirens were tested in September 2023, Stolberg's for the first time since the flood, but some sites were unbuilt so coverage was incomplete. Expansion cost about €3 million (€340,000 grants).
source: Mein Stolberg, 'Zum ersten Mal heulen auch Stolberger Sirenen am bundesweiten Warntag' (06.09.2023)
lead: Sirens, warning apps, cell broadcast, school or volunteer programmes?
Rur dike breach near Wassenberg in 2021: repair and reinforcement?
Homes damaged in Wassenberg / Ophoven: rebuilt?

finding: Bezirksregierung Köln announced on 8 December 2025 a newly set Rur flood zone (100-year flood) covering Wassenberg and eight other towns; new building, new building areas and grassland-to-arable conversion are barred, exceptions possible.
source: Bezirksregierung Köln, 'Bezirksregierung Köln setzt Überschwemmungsgebiete der Rur und Wurm neu fest' (08.12.2025)
lead: Updated flood zones on the Rur (Kreis Heinsberg)?

finding: Kreis Heinsberg and all its municipalities mapped 64 Katastrophenschutz-Leuchttürme (emergency contact points for long power cuts), within about 3 km of every resident; emergency power still to be installed (October 2023).
source: Kreis Heinsberg, 'Katastrophenschutz: Karte zeigt Leuchttürme im Kreis Heinsberg' (27.10.2023)
lead: Kreis Heinsberg evacuation and shelter plans updated?
Critical sites near the Rur: measures since 2021?

finding: Kreis Heinsberg announced a siren test across the Kreis for 12 March 2026 (state warning day); warnings also go via MoWaS, NINA, KATWARN and Cell Broadcast. Siren count and Wassenberg coverage not stated.
source: Kreis Heinsberg, 'Landesweiter Warntag: Sirenen heulen am 12. März 2026' (09.03.2026)
lead: Sirens, warning apps, cell broadcast, campaigns?

finding: Schleiden's reconstruction plan funds 10 flood-prevention projects (19.65 M EUR) on Urft, Olef and tributaries, including retention areas. By 30 June 2026 all had started, none finished; about 0.18 M EUR spent.
source: Stadt Schleiden, Kommunaler Wiederaufbauplan - Quartalsbericht zum 30.06.2026
lead: Urft and Olef works in Schleiden / Gemünd; Urft dam operation?

finding: Schleiden's 466-measure reconstruction plan (227.7 M EUR approved) stood at 216 measures started and 26 finished on 30 June 2026, with 4 fully settled; 56.4 M EUR paid out.
source: Stadt Schleiden, Kommunaler Wiederaufbauplan - Quartalsbericht zum 30.06.2026
lead: Rebuilding or demolition in Gemünd and Schleiden centre?

finding: Schleiden's February 2026 flood plan states that Kreis Euskirchen updated its flood and heavy-rain hazard maps to reflect the July 2021 event. No new Urft or Olef floodplain ordinance was found.
source: Stadt Schleiden / Feuerwehr Schleiden, Alarm- und Einsatzplan Hochwasser (Stand 04.02.2026)
lead: Updated flood zones on Urft and Olef?

finding: Schleiden's flood alarm and deployment plan (February 2026) binds city and fire brigade, sets four alert stages and lists five pre-planned shelters, two designated civil-protection beacons among them (Gemünd, Schleiden).
source: Stadt Schleiden / Feuerwehr Schleiden, Alarm- und Einsatzplan Hochwasser (Stand 04.02.2026)
lead: Kreis Euskirchen evacuation and shelter plans updated?

finding: Schleiden's 2026 flood plan lists hospitals, care homes, power, telecoms and sewage sites as endangered and calls for mobile Water-Gate barriers at emergency-service buildings flooded in 2021; stock held by fire brigade and depot.
source: Stadt Schleiden / Feuerwehr Schleiden, Alarm- und Einsatzplan Hochwasser (Stand 04.02.2026)
lead: Care homes, power and water sites in Schleiden: measures since?

finding: Schleiden's flood plan (February 2026) lists as available a warning mix of NINA and KATWARN via MoWaS, cell broadcast, sirens, social media and loudspeaker vehicles. Number of sirens is not stated.
source: Stadt Schleiden / Feuerwehr Schleiden, Alarm- und Einsatzplan Hochwasser (Stand 04.02.2026)
lead: Sirens, warning apps, cell broadcast, school or volunteer programmes?
